Stay Connected
Notify Me allows you to subscribe to an unlimited number of email lists. Receive email or text message updates regarding the information you have requested. Read on...
Report a Concern
Use Citizen Request Tracker to notify us about a general concern, comment, or compliment for unincorporated Story County areas (and outside right of ways). Read on...
November 3, 2026 - General Election
The November 3, 2026 General Election information is now available. Additional Info...
2026 Story County Citizen of the Year
Story County is excited to announce our 2026 Citizen of the Year, Susan Moore. Moore demonstrates her commitment to the Story County community through her professional and volunteer work in mental health, substance use care, and homelessness support. Read on...
Adoptable Pet of the Week
We have many fury friends that are waiting to find their forever home! Check out this week's adoptable pet of the week! Read on...
Story County Conservation seeks public input on Accessibility
Story County Conservation (SCC) is inviting the public to share feedback about accessibility at its parks and facilities. Read on...
Supermarket of Veterans Benefits
Please join us for the 2026 Story County Veterans Affairs Supermarket of Benefits on Saturday, November 7th! Read on...
Story County Releases Climate Resilience and Sustainability Plan
Story County has released its Climate Resilience and Sustainability Plan for Government Operations, a data-driven roadmap to help county facilities and services remain safe, reliable, and cost-effective as extreme weather risks evolve across central Iowa. Read on...
Submit a Proclamation Request
Do you or your organization have a cause that you would like the Board of Supervisors to consider a proclamation? Submit a request now! Additional Info...
Adopt a Road Program
Are you part of an organization that is looking to make a difference in your community? The Adopt-A-Road program allows individuals or groups to adopt a Story County road.
Story County to Move to District-Based Elections for Board of Supervisors
For the upcoming Primary and General elections, Story County will elect members of the Board of Supervisors by district, following changes mandated by Senate File 75 which passed in 2025. Read on...
Alert Center
Access various alerts including road closures, parking alerts, boil water advisories, and more. Alerts will be displayed at the top of the website when active. Visitors can also sign up to receive notifications on specific categories to always stay... Read on...
